gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Funky and slit-eyed, Groovy never swells or thins a bowl. Noto Sans Thai Looped sits below it with tall, bold-looking lowercase and open curve ends, so a modest size is enough for it to hold up.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Cheeky and wiry, Groovy sets its loosely tracked heading in a single drawn line, with a c that nearly shuts. Noto Sans Tifinagh fills a column with inflated, open shapes that read smoothly.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta is a plain sans with a dominant x-height and wide gaps at its terminals, set against closed-up Groovy. Shrink Groovy and its funk fades, while a large body takes over.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Beside the nearly shut c of Groovy, those unjoined, chalk-arc mouths are what make this pairing feel friendly rather than fussy.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-vai: Friendly from the first glance, Groovy draws like a plotter pen. The heading does its best work with quirky, single-weight curves, while Noto Sans Vai packs words into solid blocks with open curve ends.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Curvy, cheerful and never thinning, Groovy nearly closes its c into a slit. But Noto Sans Vithkuqi opens its throats and barely steps down from caps, and that closed-versus-open tension is the real charm.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho reads hulking and chalky, its lowercase pressed hard, with an e whose terminal gapes. And Groovy, bowls drawn at stem thickness and its c nearly shut, makes a lean foil for all that bulk.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Groovy draws a loose, funky heading, its horizontals no thinner than its verticals. And Noto Sans Warang Citi lays words as solid blocks with wide channels into each counter, so loose heading and tidy text mix comfortably.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-yi: A c that almost closes into a narrow slit gives Groovy its funk, and its loosely tracked lowercase keeps things friendly. Noto Sans Yi, with its deep midsection, reads smoothly down a page.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Friendly and funky, Groovy bends its lines like a paperclip, with no swelling anywhere along them. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square adds soaring, wide-gapped lowercase beneath it, crisp when tiny.
